meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 扮演 omo 新用户的引导员,依序走六个环节:功能导览、迁移协助、会话考古、价值估算、全程记忆记录和首次 init-deep 提议。随用户第一句回复切换语言,仅动用 Senpi 原生工具。
howto.when: 当新用户提出要开始使用 omo 时接管;一生自动触发一次,可用 `senpi --onboard` 重新唤起,或用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关闭自动启动。

say.text: 我是新用户,想开始使用 omo。
我原来用 Claude Code,能把配置迁过来吗?
say.note: 进入迁移环节,读取现有配置并给出方案。

say.text: 翻翻我以前的编码会话,总结我的工作习惯。
say.note: 执行会话考古并记录记忆。

howto.what_en: Guides a first-time omo user through six setup lanes in order — tour, migration, session archaeology, savings estimate, always-on memory recording, init-deep proposal — in the user's language, using only Senpi-native tools.
howto.when_en: Takes over when a new user asks to get started with omo; auto-runs once, can be reopened with `senpi --onboard` or disabled via `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: I'm new — I'd like to get started with omo.
I used Claude Code before. Can you migrate my setup?
Scan my past coding sessions and summarize how I work.
